## Simple-language progress
B310 makes the learned policy more able to influence the final decision and makes the recorded decision surface truthful. It also lets the system learn which decision source was actually useful instead of rewarding every source equally.

## Remaining 35%
The biggest remaining engineering work is not another learner. It is:
1. prove natural learned policy changes future action frequencies across controlled contexts;
2. close the policy-vs-arbitration competition problem;
3. run the benchmark on real Android/Termux hardware;
4. extend long-horizon autonomous evidence;
5. increase direct semantic verification;
6. build independent replication;
7. keep consciousness claims at evidence level only.
